## Astraeus 2.1.0

### New
- **Arrange your pages and tiles.** Under **Pages** in Settings, drag the rail's pages into any order, take one off with **×** and bring it back with **+**, the way widgets work. The Tools page's quick tiles work the same: right-click them, or use **Tools tiles** in Settings.
- **The shelf.** Drag files or text onto the top of the screen and the panel drops open on the new Shelf page, just above Tools, to keep them. Drag a card back out to drop it anywhere, or tap it to copy it.
- **Glass that reads what's behind it.** On the Glass look the tint deepens over bright pages so white text stays readable, and eases back over dark ones, following the page behind it.
- **The pill on the desktop.** Turn on **Pill on the desktop** (off by default) and the pill stays up whenever no app window is under it, after Win+D or once the last window closes.
- **A hello at sign-in.** When Astraeus starts with Windows, the Home page drops down to greet you and goes back up the moment you move the mouse.
- **Back to HaloBar.** The fullscreen player opened from HaloBar's album cover goes back to HaloBar's own player when you leave it.
- **Fullscreen controls your way.** Let the fullscreen player's controls fade while the mouse rests, or keep them up.
- **One look with HaloBar.** While Astraeus wears HaloBar's look, its opacity and blur are HaloBar's too and its own slider steps aside; HaloBar does the same while it follows Astraeus.
- **More in Settings.** Battery pills on laptops, an experimental volume and brightness pill, a weather city of your own, an accent that follows Windows, a size from 80 to 130%, and export, import and reset of all your settings.

### Fixes
- **Bluetooth shows its real state.** A Bluetooth or Wi-Fi radio that wasn't ready when Astraeus started is picked up later instead of staying "unavailable" all session.
- **Album covers are more reliable.** When a player names the new song before it swaps the picture, Astraeus looks again instead of keeping the last song's cover.
- **No more cut-off text.** Labels in Settings and the editors fit their space, and a name too long for its tile gives way to a shorter one.
- **Just Astraeus.** Task Manager now shows the plain name.

### Performance
- **Astraeus starts in a fraction of the time.** The counter behind the GPU gauge took seconds of CPU to open at every launch; it now opens in the background the first time the System page shows.
- **Less memory after the panel closes.** A pill that stays up moves to a fresh graphics device of its own size, so what the open panel used in the graphics driver goes back to Windows.
- **The glass pill copies only its own slice of the screen each frame**, not the empty strip beside it.
